examples.title: Colour web
examples.description: Cyan rays and six coloured rings, drawn with PLOT, DRAW and CIRCLE. Where a ring crosses a ray, the ray changes colour: the Spectrum keeps only one ink colour per 8 by 8 cell.

examples.title: Times table
examples.description: Asks for a number at the bottom of the screen, then prints its times table from 1 to 10.

examples.title: Catch
examples.description: Move the bat with O and P to catch the falling ball. Every catch beeps and scores a point.
